narrative.overview: A page that keeps its books where the reader can see them. Warm paper, ruled lines, tabular figures and mono headings make the site read like a ledger: every number sits on a line, with its denominator and its limits within reach. Nothing is lit, lifted or animated to persuade; the only loud thing on the page is one orange, and it marks what the reader should look at first.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, near-black ink, one signal orange.
Mono headings and labels, sans body, tabular numerals for every figure.
Flat and ruled: 1px warm lines, no shadows.
Square-ish 3px corners on every control and container.
Light and dark schemes follow the system; chart colours keep their meaning across both.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Orange means "look here": the over-31 group, Barcelona, the next link. It is never decorative, and no second accent hue competes with it.

rules.name: The Same Colour Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Under 31, exactly 31 and over 31 keep the same slate, sand and orange in every chart, legend, map layer and readout. A colour is never reassigned between sections.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared uses tabular numerals so columns and changing values do not jitter.

rules.name: The Mono For Marking Rule
rules.body: Mono marks structure and measurement (headings, labels, figures, axes). Prose is always the sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows or blurs. If something needs to stand out, change its fill or give it the orange, not elevation.

dos: Do use orange for exactly one job per view: the thing to read first.
Do keep the three minimum-stay colours the same in every chart, legend and map layer.
Do show numbers in tabular mono figures and keep each beside its denominator or limit.
Do separate sections with 1px Rule lines and a half-step Surface fill, not shadows.
Do keep touch targets at 40px (36px minimum on phones) and give every control a visible 3px focus outline.
Do reserve space (min-height) for anything that draws after data loads.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, gradients or blur anywhere.
Don't add a second accent hue, or use orange as body text colour.
Don't use round pills or large radii; 3px is the system.
Don't rely on hover for information; every tooltip has a tap or text equivalent.
Don't set prose in mono or headings in the sans.
Don't colour-code with red/green to imply good or bad; the palette is deliberately non-evaluative to match the site's neutrality.
